reasoning_trace: Traced the hidden-test run: prepare() restores only grader_protected paths (a denylist derived from files present in history), then pytest runs in the agent tree and loads any root conftest.py/pytest.ini. critique: Agent-controlled pytest configuration and stdout decide the hidden-test grade

critique: Contamination outside_path false positives on slash-commands and routes
